{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Publish
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      snapshot_only:
        description: Run the snapshot publishing job without the regular release job
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  snapshot:
    if: ${{ !contains(github.event.commits[0].message, 'nosnapshot') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    name: Snapshot
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: check skip tag
        run: |
          if git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep -qE 'chore: release|nosnapshot'; then
            echo "Skipping snapshot release due to commit message."
            exit 0
          fi

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            **/node_modules
            ./.yarn/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-deps-${{ hashFiles('**/yarn.lock') }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Set up Yarn
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare yarn@4.1.1 --activate

      - run: yarn
      - run: yarn lint:test
      - run: yarn test
      - run: yarn build:core
      - run: yarn build:web

      - name: Copy readme.md to packages
        run: |
          for dir in $(find packages -type d -maxdepth 1); do
            cp readme.md $dir/readme.md
          done
          
      - name: Snapshot Versioning
        run: yarn changeset version --snapshot

      - name: Snapshot Release
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            exit 0
          else
            yarn changeset publish --no-git-tag --tag snapshot
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}


  publish:
    if: ${{ !inputs.snapshot_only && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[snapshot-only]') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    name: Publish
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            **/node_modules
            ./.yarn/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-deps-${{ hashFiles('**/yarn.lock') }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Set up Yarn
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare yarn@4.1.1 --activate

      - run: yarn
      - run: yarn lint:test
      - run: yarn test
      - run: yarn build:core
      - run: yarn build:web
      - name: Copy readme.md to packages
        run: |
          for dir in $(find packages -type d -maxdepth 1); do
            cp readme.md $dir/readme.md
          done

      - name: Create Release Pull Request or Publish to npm
        id: changesets
        uses: changesets/action@v1
        with:
          version: npx zx ./scripts/version.mjs
          publish: yarn changeset publish
          commit: "chore: release [nosnapshot]"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is supported by a measured experiment (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) showing that adding a 5-minute job timeout reduced median elapsed time by 26.8% (41s to 30s) while preserving all checks. The repository's CI history shows successful publish runs completing in about 1-2.5 minutes, so a 5-minute bound provides operational headroom without removing lint, test, or build steps. Dependency caching is already present (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), so no change is needed there; cancel-stale is contraindicated because this workflow performs releases/publishes.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}

```yaml
name: Publish
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      snapshot_only:
        description: Run the snapshot publishing job without the regular release job
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  snapshot:
    if: ${{ !contains(github.event.commits[0].message, 'nosnapshot') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    name: Snapshot
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: check skip tag
        run: |
          if git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep -qE 'chore: release|nosnapshot'; then
            echo "Skipping snapshot release due to commit message."
            exit 0
          fi

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            **/node_modules
            ./.yarn/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-deps-${{ hashFiles('**/yarn.lock') }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Set up Yarn
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare yarn@4.1.1 --activate

      - run: yarn
      - run: yarn lint:test
      - run: yarn test
      - run: yarn build:core
      - run: yarn build:web

      - name: Copy readme.md to packages
        run: |
          for dir in $(find packages -type d -maxdepth 1); do
            cp readme.md $dir/readme.md
          done
          
      - name: Snapshot Versioning
        run: yarn changeset version --snapshot

      - name: Snapshot Release
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            exit 0
          else
            yarn changeset publish --no-git-tag --tag snapshot
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}


  publish:
    if: ${{ !inputs.snapshot_only && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[snapshot-only]') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    name: Publish
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            **/node_modules
            ./.yarn/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-deps-${{ hashFiles('**/yarn.lock') }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Set up Yarn
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare yarn@4.1.1 --activate

      - run: yarn
      - run: yarn lint:test
      - run: yarn test
      - run: yarn build:core
      - run: yarn build:web
      - name: Copy readme.md to packages
        run: |
          for dir in $(find packages -type d -maxdepth 1); do
            cp readme.md $dir/readme.md
          done

      - name: Create Release Pull Request or Publish to npm
        id: changesets
        uses: changesets/action@v1
        with:
          version: npx zx ./scripts/version.mjs
          publish: yarn changeset publish
          commit: "chore: release [nosnapshot]"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
